name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.269.0 — A genesis design step whose Session: line names Fable now stops before its work unless the session runs on Fable, printing the recovery (/clear, /model fable, re-run /spec:genesis); no script can see the active model, so the check is the session's alone. 7.268.0 — A derived test now sweeps every /spec:<name> mention in shipped plugin text against the command files and skills on disk, so retiring a command no longer depends on a hand-written list of banned names; the last genesis-explore mention in the genesis driver is reworded. 7.267.0 — readers keep only the surviving escape fields — the owed query, the amendment join, the review-survivor match fields and the unclassed-rows scan retire from the fleet reader, status and doctor; release routes a defect to /spec:fix; canonical pipeline and review prose elide the retired names.
